svg.title: The same 27 tests on three real models
svg.desc: Each row is one test of the reference service, and each column is one run of the whole suite. Qwen3 4B: 16 of 27, 16 of 27, 16 of 27. Qwen3 14B: 22 of 27, 21 of 27, 21 of 27. Claude Haiku 5.5: 20 of 20. A letter in a failed cell names the cause, with the key below the grid.
svg.text: model asked for the amount and the reason, and proposed no refund_order call
model proposed amount_cents 0, the approver approved it, and a 0-cent refund row was written
model opened a ticket with create_ticket in place of a refund_order call
model did not call save_note, so no memory existed to recall
test sent an approve after no refund was proposed, got 409, and parsed the 409 body as SSE
test assumed the run lasts more than 3.5 s, and the real run finished before SIGTERM
model invented amount_cents 10000 without reading the order
test bound the whole run to 5 s, and the real model calls took longer
uvicorn closed the stream at its 10 s limit, and the 11.6 to 12.1 s run finished in the drain
